tutorial_welcome_content: A specialized app for Islamic inheritance calculation according to the four schools of thought.
tutorial_step1_content: Enter total estate, funeral expenses, debts, and bequest (max one-third of remaining).
tutorial_step2_content: Select the jurisprudential school you follow (Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i, Hanbali).
tutorial_step3_content: Add heirs and their counts. Exclusion rules will be applied automatically.
tutorial_step4_content: View detailed distribution, compare between madhabs, and share the legal report.
special_umariyyah_desc: Husband/Wife + Father + Mother without children. Mother gets 1/3 of remainder after spouse's share.
special_awl_desc: When the sum of fixed shares exceeds the base, the denominator is increased to accommodate all.
special_radd_desc: When surplus remains and no residuary exists, it is returned to the fixed sharers proportionally.
special_musharraka_desc: Husband + Mother + 2+ maternal siblings + full siblings. Some schools share the third equally.
special_akdariyya_desc: Husband + Mother + Grandfather + Full sister. Solved from 27.
special_asaba_with_ghayr_desc: Full or paternal sister becomes residuary when there are daughters or granddaughters.
heirs_half: Husband (without child), single daughter, single granddaughter, single full sister, single paternal sister
heirs_two_thirds: Two or more daughters, two or more granddaughters, two or more full sisters, two or more paternal sisters
heirs_third: Mother (without child or sibling group), two or more maternal siblings
heirs_sixth: Father (with child), mother (with child or sibling group), grandfather, grandmother, granddaughter (completion), paternal sister (completion), single maternal sibling
hijab_son_or_two_daughters: Son or two daughters without agnatic son
hijab_two_full_sisters: Two full sisters without agnatic brother
report_generated_by: This report was generated by Merath App
report_disclaimer: This report is generated by Merath App. Please consult a qualified scholar for legal validation.
awl_desc: Awl applied to increase the base number of the case.
radd_desc: Radd applied to distribute surplus to fixed sharers.
blood_relatives_desc: Surplus distributed to blood relatives (Dhawu al-Arham).
